title: Boundaries of Baker domains of entire functions. A finer approach
summary: We consider transcendental entire functions having doubly parabolic Baker domains, such that the Denjoy-Wolff point of the associated inner function is not a singularity. We describe in a very precise way the dynamics on the boundary from a measure-theoretical point of view. Applications of such results lead to a better understanding of the topology and the dynamics on the boundaries. In particular, we improve some of the results in [N. Fagella and A.
